name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid when buying a waterfront property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common pitfalls to avoid when buying a waterfront property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls when buying waterfront property include overlooking the condition of marine structures like docks and seawalls, underestimating insurance costs, and neglecting to verify riparian rights. Another issue is not fully understanding local regulations regarding renovations or shoreline alterations. It's crucial to conduct thorough inspections and due diligence. Our agency emphasizes comprehensive property evaluations to help clients avoid these potential issues and ensure a smooth purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid pitfalls like ignoring marine structure conditions, underestimating insurance, or neglecting riparian rights and local regulations when buying waterfront property.
